content:
- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot post-peak sentiment (e.g., +0.07 sentiment → forecast 74.61 vs true 74.64, but model peaks at 77.74 → 73.08).
- Underestimate prices during negative sentiment runs; model fails to drop sharply when sentiment is negative (e.g., -0.40 sentiment → forecast 73.21 vs true 70.42).
- Lag in downward corrections: model delays price drops after negative sentiment, often missing early lows (e.g., -0.30 sentiment → forecast 73.65 vs true 70.58).
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects upward after dips, then fails to revert to mean; e.g., 72.66 → 73.88 → 73.81 → 73.16 → 73.21 → 73.65 → 73.42 → 73.05 → 73.78 → 73.39 → 72.41 → 71.76 → 71.84 → 71.41 → 71.93 → 73.83 → 74.61 → 74.50 → 77.74 → 78.28 → 78.93 → 78.36 → 73.08 → 72.86 → 72.66.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts overreact to short-term sentiment shifts; model overfits recent sentiment (e.g., -0.50 sentiment → forecast 71.21 → 71.70 → 69.89 → 71.71 → 73.37 → 73.88 → 73.88 → 73.81 → 73.16 → 73.21 → 73.65 → 73.42 → 73.05 → 73.78 → 73.39 → 72.41 → 71.76 → 71.84 →
